name: pocketprune
description: PocketPrune – Edge LLM Compression & Deployment Toolkit (BSCS FYP, Lahore Garrison University)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run worker --prefix backend"
